<!-- pr-reviewer: 54566c83dfd3c471288deb501a8874ac2ba0c627 -->
**Verdict: Needs changes before merge** (one conflict with main, otherwise sound).

**What looks good**
- Safe seam: every post's `onClose()` skips its own home only when the trip home was the last thing written (`linesWritten() === homedAt`). Anything written after it (M5/M9 from `endPreamble()`, a comment) makes the counts differ, so the close home is written as before. The home can only be dropped when the trip home already covers it, and the machine still ends retracted and homed (Fanuc/Haas/Mazak `G91 G28 Z0` + `G28 X0 Y0`, Siemens `G53 Z0` covered by the trip's `G53 Z`, lathe `G28 U0`/`W0`).
- Mid-program homes, Suppress and "Skip pauses and homes" are unchanged and pinned by the new tests.
- `linesWritten()` is documented in `docs/CNC-INTERMEDIATE.md`; decision record is in `docs/decisions/504-trailing-home.md`; no `CHANGELOG.md` edit; body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #504`; no build.rs, scripts, `.github` or dependency changes.

**Local results** (PR head, NOT merged with main because of the conflict below)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-app --test program_entry` | 9 passed |
| `--test posting` | 17 passed |
| `--test conformance` | 6 passed |
| `--test after_op` | 10 passed |
| `camcraft-post` tests | all passed (33 in the largest binary) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
1. Merge conflict with main in `assets/posts/sinumerik.cps` `onClose()` (around line 433). Main (#503) now writes the end-of-program home as `var z = safeZ(); if (z !== null) block(["G53", "Z" + fu(z)]);`, and `afterOp()`'s home (around line 342) now also uses `safeZ()` and returns early when it is refused. Please merge main and keep both: the `linesWritten() !== homedAt` guard wrapping main's `safeZ()` close home. `homedAt` is set only after the trip home is actually written, so a refused safeZ leaves `homedAt` at -1 and the close still reports/handles as main intends. Then re-run `program_entry` and the Siemens goldens, since main changed the Z value those homes use.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The five test-visible posts are covered; Heidenhain and Tormach already refuse a trip home by name, as the PR says.
- Not exercised: a real machine or simulator run, as the PR states.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
